learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the elements defining machining accuracy and metrological activities.
Using technical and specialized language in metrology activities and machining accuracy design.
Knowledge of the elements defining manufacturing and assembly accuracy of cylindrical assemblies and specific machine components.

syllabus_topics: Precision of linear dimensions. Precision of geometric form and reciprocal position.
Selection and verification of tolerances for distances between axes and surfaces
Manufacturing and assembly precision of specific machine components
Notions regarding measurement and dimensional control operations for linear and angular geometric quantities
Apparatus and instruments for measuring lengths.
Methods and means for measuring angular quantities.
Transducers used in the construction of measuring instruments
Study of machining errors using statistical calculation
Practical determination of the tolerance of the assembly characteristic (probable fits)
Design of tolerance class for clearance, intermediate, and interference fits
Measurement of linear dimensions with universal measuring instruments
Measurement of angular quantities by direct and indirect methods
Acquisition and processing of data in measurement processes

assessment_methods.method: 2 written tests during the knowledge transmission period
Formative tests for each laboratory work

assessment_rules: The minimum performance standard requires the ability to design a clearance fit and an interference fit. It also requires the ability to interpret a form deviation and a position deviation, and to present the verification method. Finally, it requires indicating usual measurement methods and means for lengths.
